public_title: MGS5 EV UK: SE vs Trophy, Battery and WLTP Range
public_meta: Compare the UK October 2025 MGS5 EV trims, battery sizes, WLTP range and useful equipment, plus charging details to clarify before buying.
public_h1: MGS5 EV: choosing UK SE or Trophy from the October 2025 brochure
public_summary: A battery badge does not settle the MGS5 EV buying decision. The UK October 2025 brochure lists two versions with a nominal 64 kWh battery, but their quoted WLTP range and convenience equipment differ. SE Long Range is the range-led choice within this comparison; Trophy Long Range is the equipment-led alternative. SE Standard Range introduces a smaller nominal battery and a different chemistry. A useful enquiry therefore names the complete trim, rather than asking only for “the 64 kWh MGS5”.
